lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct vertical white line segments are visible. Spacing is irregular, with wider gaps in the central torso region (~150-200 pixels) and closer grouping toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is truncated, terminating in the upper third of the torso mass. Posterior lines appear as dashed, discontinuous segments rather than full traversals.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory; they emerge dorsolaterally, bowing outward before curving inward and upward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White horizontal chevron on the nasal bridge; two distinct white spots on the lateral cheek; prominent dark ventral fringe (mane) extending from the throat through the brisket.
